style: Dark, cinematic, brand-led, 3D. The screen starts pure black; a tiny orange ball pops out of nowhere, crouches, jumps towards the camera (grows, stretches with speed, speed echoes), falls and hits a tilted floor (squash, rebound, small hop). Only then a shockwave of large hexagons with acid orange between the cells crosses the floor in perspective and leaves the frame; everything is black and the ball becomes the framing-L logo.
